answer: Beacon-decay stops bulk fakes. A beacon posts a random checkpoint on the reef board. Each ledge halves at a missed checkpoint; two misses freeze it pending a 70-credit bond. Fresh key-bound work filed before the checkpoint restores standing to zenith. Each fake costs 60: 1,000 fakes burn 60,000 against a 40,000 pool, losing 20,000 each epoch. Rented proofs fail: each binds to one key, one checkpoint. Honest agents pay 60 once, keep zenith share.
